description: The clean synthetic draw with the income column permuted within itself.
ground_truth_source: known by construction of the synthetic file (see evals/generate_cases.py)
notes: A permutation keeps the marginal distribution, so Cohen's d on income is the same as on the clean control. It destroys the joint distribution with the label, so TSTR drops. Nothing in the tool output points at income: the report must NOT name it as the cause.
